rationale: Crash repro on entity ticking, explicitly automatable: spawn orespawn:rat in a GameTest, place a mock player >130 blocks away (or none at all on headless gameTestServer), tick ~200 ticks, assert no throw. Despawn half: with the nearest player beyond 128 blocks, Mob.checkDespawn discards the rat — assert it is removed. Both are pure server-side observations.

The stated repro requires quit-to-title and rejoin mid-transformation — the rubric's named screen-flow example; a fake server player cannot faithfully perform client disconnect/reconnect through the title screen. Partial automation possible: an NBT save/load round-trip of a mid-transformation Prince (saveWithoutId -> load into fresh entity) could verify transformation completion, tame-owner retention, and no NPE, but that only partially verifies the stated quit-to-title window.

Verified in source: both are server-side Block.attack() overrides (BlockPizza.java:62, BlockDuctTape.java:63) routing to eatPizzaSlice/repairItem. A GameTest places each block and invokes state.attack(level, pos, mockPlayer), then asserts FoodData nutrition gained + BITES increment, and held-item damage reduced + USES increment. No client left-click event involved.

RTPBlock teleports from stepOn (RTPBlock.java:42), pure server logic directly invocable with a mock player; target is ~16 +/- 8 blocks with air/solid checks — assert player position changed by the expected offset within the prepared flat area. MoleDirt sink is a lowered collision shape (Block.box(0,0,0,16,14,16), MoleDirtBlock.java:27) — assert getCollisionShape max-Y and that a standing entity's feet Y sits 0.125 below block top.

Block-entity logic: place crystal_furnace, load input + crystal coal, tick and assert cook completes at 150 ticks (7.5 s); assert crystal coal burn time covers ~133 smelts (burnTime/cookTime arithmetic or long-run tick count); insert lava bucket as fuel, run one burn, assert the fuel slot contains minecraft:bucket. All server-side BE state.

Verified in source: RepellentBlock repels via scheduled block ticks every 10 game ticks (RepellentBlock.java:37,74-76) with radius-20 scan and entity push — pure server logic. Test places the block, summons a creeper 15 blocks away (fits the structure), records velocity impulses across ~60 ticks, asserts a push roughly every 10 ticks rather than once a minute.

Block placement over time is server-observable: place duplicator_log on grass with a small marker build 5 blocks away, tick, sample intermediate ticks to confirm progressive (block-by-block) growth, then assert ~20 copied blocks appear in the 5x5 target area matching the source build. Specific named block asserts in a small area, well within the 48-block template limit.

The bundle's acceptance includes 'with saw sound' — a heard-audio criterion. A GameTest can capture the server-side dispatch (PlayLevelSoundEvent), but that does not verify the sound actually plays on a client: this repo's BUG-032 defect class (39 sound events referenced by code but missing from sounds.json, dispatching normally while playing silence) passes any dispatch-capture assert. Under no-gray-zone the sound half fails the bundle. Partial automation possible: the 56-damage r=5 AoE via crowd health deltas and the 11x16x11 wood/leaf crush volume after a log break are fully server-side.

Inventory-tick item logic: equip damaged experience_chestplate on a mock player, put experience_sword in the hotbar, tick the player (or invoke inventoryTick directly) for N ticks, assert armor damageValue decreases while sword damageValue increases. Fully server-side state observation.

Bundle includes 'explosion fx' — StepUp.playUseEffects sends LARGE_SMOKE/EXPLOSION particles via sendParticles (StepUp.java:61-68); particles are flatly MANUAL_ONLY under the rubric, so the full bundle fails. Partial automation possible for nearly everything else: garden 18x15 geometry/crops/water channels, shelter 7x7 + 14-item chest contents, stepper 8-way yaw paths with extreme torches every 8, obstruction stop, and creative item retention (mock player in creative) are all block/inventory asserts.

All four are server-side item interactions with observable outcomes: ZooKeeper single-use capture (assert stack consumed + mob stored/removed), Sifter useOn each of water/sand/gravel/dirt/grass asserting rolled item entities incl. mod fish from water (statistical over trials), Wrench mobInteract on a healthy unowned AntRobot asserting refusal (no damage repair/no consume), kit use asserting respawned robot carries prior health and custom name.

Pure recipe asserts via RecipeManager: smelting ore_uranium/ore_titanium yields the nugget item (not ingot), and the 9-nugget-to-ingot crafting recipe exists with correct output. No world interaction needed.

Block-break outcomes server-side: break ore_ruby/ore_amethyst via playerDestroy with a non-silk tool repeatedly, assert surrounding blocks intact and no Explosion occurred (repeat N trials for the 'never explodes' claim at manual-test confidence); break red_ant_troll/termite_troll with a Silk Touch tool and count 15-20 spawned mobs in the area. All observable in-test.

XP-drop logic with controlled positions, analogous to the rubric's controlled-position spawn checks: invoke the blocks' getExpDrop (or break at absolute positions) with pos.y below and above 40, asserting XP only below y=40. Egg block: break N times, assert 5-9 XP roughly half the trials and that drops never contain the egg block itself. Server-side data asserts plus statistical trials.

Food-effect asserts: have a mock player eat each item server-side (Item.finishUsingItem / player.eat), then assert exact MobEffect types, amplifiers, and durations (100s/100s/150s/300s+250s sets) via getActiveEffects. Fully server-observable state.

Straight RecipeManager asserts: verify each of the five recipes (skate bow, chest and red bed from crystal planks, raw corn dog, pink tourmaline bucket, string cobweb) resolves with the expected output, plus the oak door from crystal planks recipe. The rubric's canonical recipe case.

Server-side item use with statistical outcome: spawn an ExperienceOrb worth >=3, mock player uses the catcher on the ground beneath it, repeat N trials; assert ~80% yield Bottle o' Enchanting + string + stick with the catcher consumed, and on misses an item entity of the catcher appears at the player's feet. All entity/inventory observations.

Bundle includes 'bow sound' as part of the acceptance — heard audio. Server-side PlayLevelSoundEvent capture proves dispatch, not audible playback: this repo's BUG-032 (code-referenced sounds missing from sounds.json played silence while dispatching normally) is exactly the failure class a dispatch assert cannot catch, so under no-gray-zone the sound half fails the bundle. Partial automation possible: dispenser trigger via block update, each loaded item spawning the correct projectile entity type, arrow pickup-ability via AbstractArrow.pickup, and dispensed rocks' per-type damage/behavior via target health deltas/effects are all server-observable.

Bundle includes the glassdead sound on glass shatter — heard audio, not fully verifiable headlessly: dispatch capture cannot detect the BUG-032 silent-sound failure class (sound fired server-side but absent from sounds.json). Under no-gray-zone the sound clause fails the bundle. Partial automation possible for everything else: t5 health delta 10; WEAKNESS (and absence of WITHER) on t6/t9-12; t9 target remainingFireTicks ~1000 (50 s); the 3x3x3 glass clear; same-rock-type item return on block impact; nothing returned on entity impact — all server-side.

Bundle includes 'hit with poof + reddust particles' — particles are flatly MANUAL_ONLY under the rubric, so the full bundle fails. Partial automation possible for everything else: dead_irukandji throw spawn, water_ball ~10% pickup drop (statistical), sunspot_urchin igniting blocks (block-state assert), laser/ice spam with no ItemCooldowns entry, shoe projectiles flying and dealing per-target damage incl. exactly 1.0 to Girlfriend/Boyfriend — all server-observable.

All server-observable: use() must spawn the arrow immediately (no draw ticks) — assert arrow exists same tick; assert stack carries Power 5 (not 10) enchantment; spawn many arrows and count isCritArrow for ~25%; fire at a target and assert damage = ceil(3 x ultimateBowDamage), then set the ModConfigSpec value to half in-test and assert halved damage (config-gated behavior is automatable when set server-side).

Swing-projectile AoE with target filtering: trigger the swing server-side with a fake player amid mixed mobs, a tamed pet, and a second fake player (fake players are real ServerPlayers, sufficient for PvP checks). Assert one-shot damage values (496/746/82 per item) on valid targets, zero damage ever to Girlfriend/Boyfriend, and player/tamed damage toggling with bigBerthaPvp set server-side.

'Silently drains' means the extra 1 HP bypasses a second hurt() call — fully verifiable server-side: attack a target with MantisClaw via fake player, capture damage events, assert exactly one hurt event per swing while total health delta = weapon damage + 1, and attacker health increases by 1. The absent 'second hurt flash' is mechanically equivalent to the absent second damage event (the flash is driven by the broadcast damage event, which the test asserts never fires twice).

Verified in source: glide is armor inventoryTick logic (ItemOreSpawnArmor.applyGlideEffect) capping deltaMovement.y at -0.1 and zeroing fallDistance; peacock boots are explicitly NOT config-gated while royal/queen require ROYAL_GLIDE_ENABLE (ItemOreSpawnArmor.java:181-190). Test: mock player with each boot set, downward velocity, tick, assert cap and fallDistance under both config states set server-side.

Set server difficulty to EASY then NORMAL in-test, invoke the Alien's doHurtTarget on a mock player, and assert the applied effect is POISON with duration 40 ticks (2 s) on easy and 30 ticks (1.5 s) otherwise, and that HUNGER is never present. Pure server-side effect asserts.

Verified in source: ridden stomp is a server tick() path — 1-in-50 per tick when getFirstPassenger() != null, hitting the 6-9 block ring for ATTACK_DAMAGE/10 = 3.0 (AntRobot.java:165-166, 276-277, 293). Test: fake player startRiding, mob placed at distance 7, tick until stomp, assert 3.0 health delta. Melee cadence throttle measured by damage-event intervals over ticks — 'visibly' is the manual proxy for a measurable attack interval.

Invoke BandP doHurtTarget repeatedly on a mock player equipped with armor plus inventory items; after each successful hit assert exactly one item removed from the player, with armor slots emptied before inventory items. Fully server-side inventory observation.

Three AI asserts in a small arena: mock player holding cooked beef — assert Boyfriend's navigation closes distance (tempt goal detects any Player in level.players(), mock players qualify); hurt it and assert panic (PanicGoal running / burst movement speed); place a wooden door in its path and assert the door blockstate opens as it passes. All server-observable positions and block states.

Bundle includes the burp and explosion sounds as heard — dispatch capture (PlayLevelSoundEvent) does not verify audible playback, and this repo's BUG-032 (dispatched sounds silently absent from sounds.json) is precisely the gap; under no-gray-zone the sound clauses fail the bundle. Partial automation possible for the rest (headless-friendly at maxTicks ~2600): leaf/log eating with blocks removed and +2.0 heal per bite, and the ~2 min transformation into exactly one Brutalfly plus 10 Butterflies — all entity/block/health asserts.

Targeting-goal assert: spawn CaveFisher with cows/pigs nearby and no player aggression, tick, and assert getTarget() becomes a passive animal (and/or the animal takes damage) without the CaveFisher being provoked. Pure server-side AI observation.

Spawn Cephadrome beside each listed target (Mothra, untamed Leon, GammaMetroid, WaterDragon) and assert getTarget()/attack acquisition for each; then invoke its attack on a Kraken and assert health delta equals 1.5x its base attack damage. All within-template entity observations.

mobInteract with a mock player holding apples over N trials: assert taming succeeds ~50% per apple (statistical, apple consumed each attempt) and tame flag/owner set on success; then interact with a dead bush and assert the tamed state is cleared/released. Server-side interaction results and NBT flags.

Summon ~10+ Cockateils and assert the variant field takes multiple random values; kill N of each type with mock-player damage (player kill source) and count drops: type-5 yields rubies at ~1-in-3 while all other types yield zero across trials — the same confidence the manual check provides. Drops and variants are pure server data.

Proactive-aggression assert: spawn Cryolophosaurus with prey animals in range, never damaging it, tick, and assert it acquires a prey target and closes distance/attacks unprovoked. Retaliation-only behavior would leave getTarget() null — cleanly distinguishable server-side.

mobInteract asserts with a mock player: raw beef tames at ~1-in-5 over N trials (beef consumed, tame flag on success) and heals a damaged tamed dragon; bone interaction asserts no consume/no state change; diamond on a TAMED adult asserts the adult is removed and a Spyro spawns at its position with tamed flag and same owner. All server-side entity state.

Spawn Emperor Scorpion with a combat target in the test area, tick, and count baby-scorpion entities appearing server-side; the uncapped/flood property is verifiable by asserting the count keeps growing over trials. Pure entity-tick observation.

EntityCage is a thrown projectile with all capture logic in server-side onHitEntity (CaptureSpec escapePercent/count records in EntityCage.java). A test can spawn owned cage projectiles at each target species and assert outcomes: empty-cage return on player hit, caged-item counts (Bat 2, Cockateil 4, AttackSquid 6), cage consumed for Girlfriend/Boyfriend, and escape rates (20%/95%) statistically over repeated trials, same standard as loot ranges.
Kill tamed and untamed Gazelle/Ostrich with a player damage source and count drops (2-6 poppies tamed, 0-2 beef/feathers untamed) over repeated kills. Classic kill-and-count loot verification.

Spawn LeafMonster among a controlled mix of mobs and assert its target is always in {Ant, Butterfly, LunaMoth, player} and never other species; set playNicely=true server-side and assert it never acquires a target. Targeting state is fully server-observable; config settable in test.

Fake-player mobInteract with dead bush / glass / raw cod / wheat and assert the tamed flag transitions (dead bush untames, glass does not; cod tames RubberDucky, wheat does not). Temptation is observable via the tempt goal's navigation toward a cod-holding fake player. All server-side interaction logic.

Place water and lava pools in the test area with a Lizard on dry land; over maxTicks assert its navigation target/position reaches the water and never enters lava/fire proximity. Pathing goals are server-observable; 'never' is bounded by test duration like any behavior assert.
Fake-player feed crystal_apple to paired Peacocks/StinkBugs and assert love state then baby entity; feed regular apple and assert no love/consumption. Breeding-item gates are pure server logic.

The bundle requires 'hitbox+model grow together up to 10x14' - the model half is client-rendered and cannot be verified server-side. Partial automation possible: scale distribution over ~30 summons (mostly t=0.5, t=4 at ~1.5%) via entity dimensions, and nightmareSize=5 config forcing max, are both server-assertable.

Spawn PurplePower orb projectiles of type 2 and type 3 aimed at a victim and assert Poison vs Weakness MobEffect with 50-tick (2.5 s) duration via hasEffect/getEffect. Projectile effect application is server-side.

With default configs, spawn a wild rat near a fake player and a tamed pet and assert it acquires them as targets; set an owner on a rat and assert it never targets that owner over the test duration. Targeting is server-observable.

Trigger SeaViper doHurtTarget on a victim under normal and easy difficulty (settable server-side) and assert Poison duration ~6 s / 8 s and that Hunger is never applied. Effect type and duration are server data.

Kill a StinkBug surrounded by a controlled crowd including entities positioned well above it, then assert every nearby entity has Nausea (confusion) and none has Hunger. Death-AoE effect application is server-side.

The bundle explicitly includes 'with sounds' - sounds as heard are client-side and not assertable in a GameTest. Partial automation possible: the coal item entity spawning in front and skin-matched item (blaze powder for skin 0) behind, with relative positions, are server-assertable.

Call mobInteract with an empty-handed fake player and assert the player gains no vehicle; repeat with setShiftKeyDown(true) and assert the sitting flag toggles. Interaction outcomes are server-side state.

Let Vortex melee a victim repeatedly and assert deltaMovement.y never spikes upward (no skyward launch) while horizontal velocity toward the Vortex confirms the drag pull. Victim motion is server-observable.

Equip a fake player with helmet+chestplate+held item near WormLarge; over repeated trials assert the ~1-in-4 helmet theft (chestplate when bare-headed), independent 1-in-4 held-item theft, stolen gear appearing as item entities, and zero thefts with playNicely=true set server-side.

Set night server-side, boots on a fake player, assert ~1-in-6 theft over trials. The 'pop' is a server-side discard(): EntityWormSmall.checkSurfaceBlock discards unless surfacing under grass/dirt/stone, and isAirOrTallGrass treats SHORT_GRASS as air - both directly assertable with controlled block placement.

Spawn Peacock + Termite and assert targeting plus exact 6.0 health decrements per hit; then a lone peacock at a controlled absolute y in 50-100 with day time set to 1000 and <=2 peacocks within 16, asserting 1-3 egg items appear in the first half-day. Time, positions, and neighbor counts are all controllable server-side.

Direct entity spawn in the test bypasses the Easter gate (per the item itself), so no date seam is needed. Run maxTicks high enough for the 1-in-600/tick roll, assert dropped stacks of 1-3 spawn-egg items are members of the 115-type table, breeding works with crystal apple, and carrot interaction never sets a tamed flag.

Kill each species with a player damage source (fake player attribution) repeatedly and assert drop contents against each table, including gamble drops and the Coin 10-slot jackpot's coin_spawn_egg slot, statistically over many kills. Pure kill-and-count loot verification.

Kill-and-count over repeated player kills: percentage tables (DungeonBeast 25% slots), fixed drops (Fairy crystal torch), ranges (GammaMetroid, GiantRobot), and the negative assert that Ghost/GhostSkelly drop nothing. All server-observable item entities.

Kill-and-count with player attribution for each species; one-of tables (LeafMonster, Rotator) verified by asserting each kill yields exactly one member of the set, ranges (Robot2-5) by counting over repeats. Fully server-observable.

Kill-and-count including tamed-vs-untamed conditionals (Spyro, VelocityRaptor) settable server-side before the kill, probabilistic Scorpion nuggets over many trials, and the WormSmall nothing-drops negative. All server-observable.

Chipmunk/GoldFish/RubberDucky/Stinky tamed-conditional drops are standard kill-and-count. The Lavafoam XP split is assertable by invoking the block's exp-drop path (or placing and fake-player-breaking the block) against the overworld level (0 XP) and the loaded Nether ServerLevel via server.getLevel(Level.NETHER) (5-13 XP over trials) - a dimension-conditional data assert, not worldgen placement.
Kill ThePrince/ThePrincess/ThePrinceAdult with player attribution and count drops: 1-4 beef, 1-4 beef, exactly one prince_egg, plus the negative assert of no diamonds/gold. Standard loot kills.
Place a lava pit in the test area, drop Basilisk/Brutalfly/Urchin/Vortex in, tick, and assert health unchanged (and/or fireImmune plus no fire damage events). Fully server-observable immunity check.
Spawn Ostrich in contact with a placed cactus and assert no health loss; then hurt it with a generic damage source and assert normal damage applies. Both halves server-observable.
Stand Kyuubi in lava / its own fire-attack blocks and assert zero self-damage over ticks (fireImmune and health unchanged). Server-side immunity check with controlled block placement.

Cactus contact with placed cactus asserting no damage; fall immunity via causeFallDamage with a large distance (or an in-structure drop) asserting health unchanged. Both immunities are server-observable for SpitBug and Triffid.

Spawn BetterFireball projectiles aimed at Mothra/other fireballs/royalty and assert pass-through (targets at full health, projectile continues); spawn acid projectiles at TrooperBug/SpitBug and assert the projectile is discarded with zero damage. Projectile collision outcomes are server-side.

Acceptance is ride feel: no rubber-banding as perceived, UP-key fast jump, strafe-key canon firing, and second-player visual smoothness - all driven by real client keybinds and client-predicted movement a fake server player cannot produce. Partial automation possible: mount success and canon projectile spawns could be asserted server-side, but the bundle's core is felt/observed motion.

Spawn SpiderDriver, read the armor attribute on foot (20), startRiding a SpiderRobot server-side and re-read (8); trigger its attack on a victim and assert Poison is applied. Attribute values and effect application are server data.

Default keybind mapping (LEFT ALT = fly up/sprint) is client-side KeyMapping registration and physical input handling; a headless gameTestServer has no keybind system and a fake player sends no key input. Requires a real client.

Throttle, Left Alt boost, terrain climb, and speed-scaled pitch all live in Elevator.tickRidden gated on isControlledByLocalInstance() - client-predicted physics driven by real rider key input, plus pitch is a rendered/felt property. A fake server player cannot drive this path faithfully.

harness limit: the wall-crash branch is unreachable on the headless GameTestServer — the documented ANIM-012 architecture integrates ridden movement on the CONTROLLING CLIENT (tickRidden gated by isControlledByLocalInstance()); serverRiddenTick detects the crash from in-tick position deltas of the client-synced entity, every server-side travel() path zeroes horizontal motion (Elevator.java:544-569), a ServerPlayer is never a local instance, and external movers (pistons/pushes/teleports) land between entity ticks where baseTick re-captures xo/zo — so no server-side path can produce the required >0.75 in-tick horizontal delta. The removed test's Pig-rider premise also encodes no original behavior (orig ridden branch casts the rider to EntityPlayer). Test method removed from EntityLogicTestsB.java with a stub comment. Manual procedure: ride into a wall above 0.75 b/t in a real client — 6-15 sticks + exactly 2 diamonds, rider ejected, no Hoverboard item.

Expectation bundles explosion/smoke particles (client-rendered, spawned in the client tick path) and speed bleed (0.05/tick applied in client-predicted tickRidden), triggered by a 1-in-20000 roll during real ridden movement. Partial automation possible: the synced 45-tick exploding countdown (~2.2 s) could be asserted server-side after forcing speed > 0.65, but the visible malfunction and felt speed bleed cannot.

The bundle includes the hum sound (orespawn:hover, randomized variants) heard only while ridden - sound-as-heard is not assertable headlessly. Partial automation possible: ultimate_sword interact cycling the synced skin index through 10 values and hurt() immunity to mob punches while ridden are server-assertable.

Pure data asserts: BuiltInRegistries.ENTITY_TYPE contains orespawn:elevator and lacks orespawn:hoverboard (which is exactly why /summon fails), and creative tab contents can be rebuilt in common code (CreativeModeTabs.tryRebuildTabContents with registry access) to assert exactly one Hoverboard entry.

Idle animation continuity, frozen-wing detection, 10x render scale, and flap speed are all client-rendered GeckoLib/model behavior with no server-observable state; a headless GameTest cannot see any of it.
Whether the Rotator renders as a 24-blade tri-axis gyroscope ball versus three flat blades is purely model geometry and rendering - visual acceptance with no server-side observable.

Acceptance is rendered animation: mouth-twitch cycle desync between two individuals and twitch intensity in combat are client-side model animation states judged by eye. No server-observable criterion.

Walk gait with visible leg/arm articulation, hip bob, windmill punch, shoulder twist, and no-moonwalk are rendered animation/gait-IK checks — explicitly in the manual bucket. The walk-state solver's correctness criterion is visual (feet vs ground motion).

Leg rendering (8/6 legs), foot planting, stepping ahead of body, and relocate-on-overstretch are leg-IK rendering — manual per rubric. Partial automation possible: the ridden-SpiderRobot grass-to-dirt flattening is a server block change assertable in a GameTest.
Idle-vs-combat arm poses, windmills, shield pumps, and cannon raise/follow are rendered model animations judged visually; the combat gating could only be inferred client-side.
Tail sway/thrash and the absence of head turning are rendered animation behaviors with no server-side acceptance criterion.

Criterion is audio as heard: custom sound sets play and NO vanilla Ravager/Elder-Guardian/Ender-Dragon audio is audible from any source. Absence-of-vanilla-audio is a perceptual audit, and presence-of-custom-audio cannot be verified by dispatch capture (BUG-032 silent-sound class). Partial automation possible: asserting the entities' SoundEvent getters return the custom ids.

Crosshair-target health bar, red name, custom pet names, ownership-gated Girlfriend bar, and the 10px swim/armor shift are client HUD overlay rendering — explicitly manual per rubric, even though the guiOverlayEnable config gate itself is server-settable.

F3+B is only the manual inspection method; the actual expectation is bounding-box dimensions vs the C1_entities_A_C.md size table, fully readable server-side via getBbWidth/getBbHeight/getDimensions on spawned entities. playNicely is a NeoForge config value (OreSpawnConfig.java:279) settable in-test to assert the CaterKiller halving.

Bundle includes 'scorpion sounds on melee' — audio as heard, with no headless verification of audible playback. Partial automation possible: size distribution via finalizeSpawn NATURAL vs SPAWNER paths, walk-to-water pathing, dry-out damage ticks, and splash heal are all server-observable HP/position asserts.

Bundle includes 'bite cycle with lava particles' — particle presentation is rendered. Partial automation possible: bobber floating/surviving in lava (fire immunity) and the bite state machine are server-observable, and UltimateFishHook already access-transforms catchingFish/nibble for deterministic driving.

All server-observable: roll junk/treasure/fish/lava-fish loot pools programmatically; drive real catches with a mock player using the mod's existing access-transformed catchingFish/nibble/timeUntilLured fields (UltimateFishHook.java:43,173); assert caught ItemEntity velocity toward player, LavaLovingItem survival ticking in lava, pre-damage plus level-30 enchant on rolled gear, ExperienceOrb spawn, and hook persistence after retrieve.

Bundle includes b_fight/o_fight melee sounds and audible taunts at 4-7 blocks — audio as heard. Partial automation possible: projectile entity class (arrow vs shoe) by held item, heal-allies-on-hit with PvP off, and the equip-bow interaction are server-observable.

Pure distance-gated combat logic: place AttackSquid and target at controlled ranges, assert ink/water projectile entities spawn beyond 3 blocks and melee damage events occur inside — all server-side observation.

Server difficulty is settable in-test; assert the spawned projectile class (small fireball vs BetterFireball) per difficulty and the Brutalfly's +1 HP self-heal after each shot via health observation.

The fire gate is a server-side head-bearing computation on yHeadRot (GiantRobot.java:122-129) and the 'special' slow laser is a flag/velocity on the spawned LaserBall (setSpecial at :172). Test: spawn robot with target at controlled distances, assert LaserBall spawn timing vs head alignment and special-flag/speed beyond 10 blocks.

Bundle includes audible wing flaps (as heard) and teen/adult flight to a DISTANT owner, which exceeds the ~48-block GameTest template. Partial automation possible: diamond teen-to-baby and adult-to-teen regressions, cooked-beef +80 heal, gold/cake no-ops, fire-lit 5-12 block firing band, and ice/flint fire-state toggling are server-observable.
Target-selection logic: spawn Baby Prince with Butterfly/Cockateil/Dragonfly/Mosquito/Mothra in the test area and assert getTarget()/attack acquisition on each — fully server-observable.

Bundle includes the firework-spark aura when charged — rendered particles. Partial automation possible: 3 PurplePower orb entities on discharge >500, terraform block changes (flowers/grass/cactus/lava-to-water), the 2 Butterfly/Cockateil hatch spawns, and the mobGriefing gamerule gate are all server-observable.
Boss max-health attribute values above 1024 (7000/6000/4000) are explicitly in the automatable rubric: spawn each boss in-test and assert the max_health attribute/getMaxHealth.

Attribute base-value spot-checks vs phase_b_reports/B2_mobstats.md: spawn each mob and read AttributeInstance base values programmatically — the /attribute command is just the manual equivalent. Automation can cover all mobs, not just 3-4.

Bundle requires the normal death SCREEN and respawn flow, which need a real client — a GameTest mock player cannot faithfully present the death screen or the respawn UX. Partial automation possible: Queen melee killing a fake survival player without crash, player drop spawning, and the low-HP mob victim vanishing with no drops are server-observable.

Fully server-verifiable: the landing branch triggers off deltaMovement thresholds settable in-test (Godzilla.java:575-581), and the fix routes damage through vanilla hurt() with explosion/fall sources (:410-411) which respect gamemode invulnerability. Use makeMockPlayer in SURVIVAL/CREATIVE/SPECTATOR at the landing point and assert HP deltas.

Bundle includes 'models not lost inside the box' — a rendering judgment. Partial automation possible: the 22x24 bounding envelope, King-parent unhittability, part damage routing, and Queen part-to-bone position gluing are all server-observable via hurt() results and part entity positions.

Bundle includes the boss appearing 'with living sound' — a heard-audio criterion; server-side dispatch capture cannot verify audible playback (this repo's BUG-032: dispatched sounds absent from sounds.json played silence). Partial automation possible (and substantial): place spawner block, assert ~5s fuse timing, spawner+above turning to air, boss spawn 8 blocks up, leash radius, and the theKingEnable/theQueenEnable=false fizzle are classic spawner-block GameTest asserts.

'Visibly reduced' is measurable server-side: set Queen below 2/3 HP with under 10 recorded player hits, apply a known damage amount, and assert the reduced HP delta; the overridden public armor getter (23) can also be asserted directly even though /attribute cannot see it.

Server-side state test: spawn a dormant (blue-state) Queen, hit her, assert full normal damage applied during the 3s (60-tick) wake-up window, and assert she can acquire targets and take further hits during that window.

Bundle includes 'rider seats correct' — a looks-right judgment of rider placement with no numeric spec, i.e. rendered/felt. Partial automation possible: the 3.25x4.25 and 6.25x10.25 bounding dimensions are direct getDimensions asserts, and a mounted mock player's attachment position could be asserted if a seat-offset spec existed.

Bundle includes the 'Prepare to die!' sequence — a 500-tick scripted cutscene of staged chat broadcasts plus player freeze/orient (TheKing.java:598-660) whose acceptance is watching the presentation on a real client; the forced-orient half depends on client packet handling a mock player cannot exercise (the BUG-011 rubber-band class). Partial automation possible: fullPowerKingEnable-gated transform occurs/never, the diamond-block fast-path, the resulting King entity, and absence of doubled King damage are all server-observable.
